# First-to-default basket (`first-to-default` v1)

Pays on the first default among a small basket of names.

**Asset class:** Credit · **Family:** cds · **Product type:** `FIRST_TO_DEFAULT`

Applies to trades whose `productType` is `FIRST_TO_DEFAULT`. Open one with `TRD <tradeId>`.

```sutra
sutra: first-to-default
version: 1
description: Pays on the first default among a small basket of names.
match: { kind: trade, where: "$.productType == 'FIRST_TO_DEFAULT'", priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Credit · First-to-default basket, id: $.tradeId, with: "link($.counterparty.id, 'counterparty', $.counterparty.name)" }
strip:
  - { label: Notional, bind: "$.currency + ' ' + fmt($.notional, 'amount0')" }
  - { label: Direction, bind: $.direction }
  - { label: Trade date, bind: $.tradeDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: Maturity, bind: $.maturityDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: MTM (USD), bind: $.mtm, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: CS01 (USD), bind: $.risk.cs01, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Jump to default (USD), bind: $.risk.jtd, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: terms
    kind: kv
    title: Terms
    code: TRM
    key: F2
    columns:
      - { label: Names, bind: $.terms.basketSize, fmt: amount0 }
      - { label: Spread, bind: $.terms.spread, fmt: bp1 }
      - { label: Effective, bind: $.effectiveDate, fmt: date }
      - { label: Counterparty, bind: $.counterparty.name }
  - id: schedule
    kind: table
    title: Constituents
    code: CON
    key: F3
    rows: $.schedule
    columns:
      - { label: Name, bind: "@.name" }
      - { label: Weight, bind: "@.weight", fmt: pct2 }
      - { label: Spread / level, bind: "@.level", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: Status, bind: "@.status", tone: status }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - id: marketData
    kind: line
    title: "Credit curve: Par spreads (bp)"
    code: CDS
    key: F4
    area: right
    source: "link($.creditCurve, 'credit-curve')"
    rows: points
    x: tenor
    y: spread
    fmt: price2
  - id: sensitivities
    kind: hbar
    title: CS01 by bucket (USD)
    code: SENS
    area: right
    rows: $.sensitivities
    label: bucket
    value: cs01
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - id: pnl
    kind: line
    title: Daily P&L, last 20 days (USD)
    code: PNL
    area: right
    rows: $.pnlHistory
    x: date
    y: pnl
    fmt: signed0
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.nettingSet, 'netting-set')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

## Terms

Product-specific terms live under `terms` in the trade document.

| Field | Label | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `terms.basketSize` | Names | `amount0` |
| `terms.spread` | Spread | `bp1` |

## Market data

Reference fields on the trade point at the market data it is valued with. They show under *Linked entities* and drive F8 impact ("which trades use this curve?").

| Field | Kind | Selected by |
|---|---|---|
| `creditCurve` | `credit-curve` (Credit curve) | `{issuer}` |
| `discountCurve` | `ir-curve` (Interest rate curve) | `ois:{ccy}` |
| `correlation` | `correlation-matrix` (Correlation matrix) | `{corr}` |

## Risk

| Measure | Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| CS01 | `risk.cs01` | value change for a 1 bp widening of credit spreads |
| Jump to default | `risk.jtd` | loss if the reference entity defaults now |

The *CS01 by bucket* chart reads `sensitivities[].cs01`.

## Constituents

`schedule` rows (table), F3: `name`, `weight`, `level`, `status`.

## Layout notes

- The strip leads with size and dates, then MTM (emphasised) and the product's main risk measures.
- F2 is the terms, F3 the schedule, F4 the market data it is most sensitive to; F7 opens the netting set, F8 shows impact and F9 the raw document.
- Common fields (counterparty, netting set, book, trader, MTM, P&L) are described in the pack guide.
